decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (E01; E02; E03; E04 Rev: A; E05 Rev: A; E06; E07; P100; P101; RP01 Rev: A; RP02 Rev: C; RP03 Rev: B; RP04; RP06; RP07; Unnumbered Design and Access Statement; Unnumbered Heritage Statement. Received: 29/03/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until full details, including material specifications, of any plasterwork and/or skirting have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until elevational drawings of new partition walls and 1:20 scale drawings of all new joinery have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly. New joinery should be a sympathetic design and colour in relation to the historic character.

Condition : 5 - No development take place until detailed drawings of the plumbing/servicing routes and their housing have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly.

Condition : 6 - All work shall be carried out in accordance with the recommendations set out within the submitted Heritage Statement (Unnumbered) and received on 29/03/2018, unless any deviation or variation is agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - In the case of intervention in original walls, nibs and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.
Condition : 8 - All new or disturbed work to the interior of the building shall be finished to match the existing.

Condition : 9 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling service, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as shown on the approved drawings.
